claims.quote: Nemachilichthys rueppelli is a nemacheilid loach from the upper Krishna River system in the Western Ghats, India.

regions.name: Krishna River
regions.quote: Nemachilichthys rueppelli is currently known only from the upper reaches of the east-flowing Krishna River system in the Western Ghats.
